summary: A labelled meter in five intents, split into shares or read as an amount, with an optional icon and description.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value. With `segments`, their sum takes its place.

props.name: min
props.description: Defaults to Base UI's own Meter minimum (0).

props.name: max
props.description: Defaults to Base UI's own Meter maximum (100).

props.name: label
props.description: Text above the track, correctly wired to it via Base UI's own Meter.Label.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the label. Only shown alongside `icon` - without one there is no header block for it to sit in.

props.name: icon
props.description: A leading avatar. Setting this switches the header to a grouped icon+label+description block & moves the value display below the track instead of beside the label. It sits in a fixed 32px tile that colors the glyph but does not resize it, so pass one sized to fit (`w:4 h:4`).

props.name: segments
props.description: Splits the bar into shares, each a lighter step of the intent, with a legend under the track. Up to three; a fourth repeats the last color.

props.name: unit
props.description: Reads the value as an amount, `12.7 of 20 GB`, in place of a percentage.

props.name: rest
props.description: Names the empty part of the track in the legend, `Free` for storage.

props.name: intent
props.description: What the reading means, not which hue it is. The five map to Yumma families in the shipped `INTENTS` table; point one somewhere else and the type follows.

props.name: animated
props.description: The indicator's width transition as `value` changes.
